g.text: Overlapping school ties | Fixed baseline ties
Full C08 controls | 95% province-clustered t CIs
N = 1,155; 229 officials; 17 provinces. Tied observations at k=-4,...,+4: 3, 4, 7, 8, 4, 2, 0, 0, 0.
Gray periods: no tied observations; no estimate. Unknown ties are excluded. The reference is normalized, without an estimated CI.
Economics follow the official's appointment city (lagged one year). Sparse connected groups limit province-clustered inference.
